purpose: A public-document evidence availability audit for investment objectives, strategies, explicit rules, source identity and document dates; not a frozen gold packet.
sampling_note: The four funds are accessibility candidates, not a representative sample. No arbitrary fact or document quota is imposed by this inventory.
readiness: Official evidence is available for all four funds; final source version, cutoff eligibility, amendment chain, content hashes and independent human gold review remain required.
access_note: Direct data.sec.gov Submissions requests returned HTTP 403 for all four CIKs during this audit. No retry, identity rotation, proxy or other circumvention was used. Evidence below was read through normal web retrieval of official public sources. Some fund-manager URLs are mutable.
date_rule: Document cover date, report-as-of date, publication/filing date, revision/supplement date and retrieval date are distinct. A current PDF bearing an old cover date is not automatically eligible for the historical cutoff.

packet_build_next_steps: Confirm A's actual cutoff policy; current-document audit and historical point-in-time audit are different tasks.
Freeze accessible official original bytes and hashes, retain source identifiers and document/supplement dates; do not infer historic eligibility from the cover date.
Choose answer roles from actual source content, retaining normal-circumstance qualifiers, denominators, exceptions and source locations.
Build absent/insufficient answers relative to the supplied corpus; do not treat an omitted field as proof that a fund has no such rule anywhere.
Keep full-portfolio compliance probes conditional on sufficient supplied totals and membership facts. No full holdings-to-industry map is required for document comprehension.
Complete an independent second human review before treating this inventory's paraphrases as gold.
